California Governor Signs Bills on Environmental Exemptions and Holidays

California Governor Gavin Newsom has signed legislation that provides environmental exemptions for a San Diego stadium project. Additionally, he has signed bills into law establishing Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha as new state holidays in California.
